preserveIntent.originalMessage: Jalapeño returns a complete response faster than the comparison systems across GPT-OSS, DeepSeek R1, and Kimi K2.5.
preservedElements: GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek R1 670B, and Kimi K2.5 1T in the original order
Jalapeño versus GB200 or GB300 comparison for every model
Exact end-to-end latency values in seconds
OpenAI source URL and official comparison labels
changedElements: Recomposed the comparisons as a grouped bar chart for quick model-by-model reading
Used direct labels with the comparison hardware name and exact two-decimal seconds
Added a short plain-language English headline and subtitle
Kept a shared zero-based seconds axis; no inversion or normalization was introduced
preserveIntent.notes: All six latency values are copied from OpenAI’s official appendix. Lower bars mean a shorter wait for the complete response.

narrative.summary: End-to-end latency is the time from sending a request to receiving the complete response.
